intro: A singed letter that Dorius let fall is written to his brother. It tells of the Suntara stones, which are real and in the hands of the Dark Irons, whose leader Lathoric the Black uses their power to enslave Dorius's excavation team. It is meant for Thorius at the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge, and you are the one to carry it there.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you are reading this letter, I am no more. How it got to you, I do not know, but thank and reward the ones responsible.

About the stones: They exist and the Dark Irons have them in their possession. Their leader, Lathoric the Black, is using the power of the stones to enslave my excavation team. They were taken to the cauldron. Their minds are twisted, working night and day to complete something called Obsidion.
Help them, brother. It is the final wish of a dead man.

clips.title: Completion
paras: In the name of the Light, he will have his wish. This I vow.
